name: Gluttony

features.name: xZone Sauce
features.description: Adds +1 multiplier to every neighbouring symbol.

features.name: Silver and Golden Bells
features.description: Two scatter types that shape the bonus.

review:
A messy 5x5 food fight with two scatters: silver bells on reels 2 to 4 and golden bells elsewhere. xZone Sauce adds +1 to the multiplier of every symbol and wild around it, including diagonals, and sauces can overlap.

Wild Pots only show up in the bonus modes – from Order Up! to FEDCON 1 – acting as wilds with extra effects. Loud, chaotic and very Nolimit. High volatility, 32,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
